monologue: The card sits at fifty, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am calm. The town is quiet. I rest by the Wide Anchor. The weight settles. I do not check the Sharp Root’s point. The leaf is steady. I feel the heat of the busy work leaking out the top. It is not a lid. It is just pressure. I want to stay here. The floor is solid. I am not restless. I am not lonely. I am just here, holding the line. The air is still. I wait for the next minute to pass.

action.why: The line is steady and there is no new weight to catch.

diary: The card sits at fifty, a warm hand. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds.
